bounds_order: [west, south, east, north], degrees, cell edges
grid: equirectangular lon/lat; in deck.gl set _imageCoordinateSystem: COORDINATE_SYSTEM.LNGLAT

downsample.method: mean of all cells per block (T-014)

extent_note: shared map extent = relief bounds; every web/data map layer is clipped to it (T-011)
ocean: transparent outside the Natural Earth 10m land polygons (T-014)
lakes: transparent inside the water.topojson lake polygons (T-011)
source: NOAA NCEI 2022, ETOPO 2022 30 arc-second (ice surface), https://doi.org/10.25921/fd45-gt74

colour.method: linear in sRGB on the stretched shade (T-014)

land_mask.source: Natural Earth 10m physical land v5 (Kelso and Patterson, n.d.), public domain, https://naciscdn.org/naturalearth/10m/physical/ne_10m_land.zip
land_mask.rule: pixel opaque when its centre lies in the mask (T-014)
